blocks.text: IT is moving the shared drive to a new server this weekend, so it will be offline while they work. Their notice sets the window for Saturday night, but they have asked us to plan on it being down through Sunday to be safe.

Before you leave Friday, please close your workbooks and confirm nothing under Michelle Banks is still checked out; the file locks do not always clear on their own. If one will not release, let me know and I will flag it to IT. I will be reachable by phone over the weekend if the cutover runs long, but there is nothing to do until Friday.
